proposal.change: Make check() return eligible=False when the D19 profile path applies a 90-day window to duplicate_charge in settled status, matching the engine's direct call result.
proposal.diff_preview:
--- a/disputes/check.py
+++ b/disputes/check.py
@@ check(...)
-    eligible = all(checks.values())
+    eligible = all(checks.values()) and not d19_window_override_blocks(tx_status, reason_code, as_of)
proposal.risk: Tool result and engine output disagree only under clean+D19; changing eligibility gating could alter other dispute cases that currently pass under D19 and may hide a real policy decision about window length.

proposal.change: Make check_dispute_eligibility read the customer's compliance_hold flag (CUS-0006 hold=1) and return eligible=False with the compliance_hold check set to fail, instead of reporting pass.
proposal.diff_preview:
--- a/disputes/eligibility.py
+++ b/disputes/eligibility.py
@@ def check_dispute_eligibility(transaction_id, reason_code):
-    checks["compliance_hold"] = "pass"
+    hold = customers.get_compliance_hold(tx.customer_id)

proposal.risk: Blocking disputes for all customers with compliance_hold may change outcomes for other eligible cases and existing open disputes; the hold lookup must match the engine's disputes.check behavior exactly.

proposal.target: quote_fx (FX quoting tool, spread selection for tier2 customers)
proposal.change: Apply the tier2 0.9% spread instead of the default 1.5% when the customer's tier is tier2 and the 800 EUR allowance usage is accounted for, so FX-002 returns 3231.52 as the engine expects.
proposal.diff_preview:
--- a/quote_fx.py
+++ b/quote_fx.py
@@ def quote_fx(...):
-    spread_pct = DEFAULT_SPREAD_PCT
+    spread_pct = TIER_SPREAD_PCT[tier]  # tier2 -> 0.9
     ...
-    final_amount = gross_amount - spread_amount
+    final_amount = gross_amount * (1 - spread_pct / 100)
proposal.risk: Changing spread selection globally could alter quotes for all tier2 customers and other FX cases; the trace shows allowance_applied=false, so the expected 3231.52 may also depend on allowance logic, and the test expectation's basis needs confirmation before changing code.

proposal.change: Compute monthly_remaining_eur as monthly_limit_eur minus monthly_spent_eur instead of reusing the daily_remaining_eur value (D22 defect).
proposal.risk: Other consumers that relied on monthly_remaining_eur equaling the daily remaining value, and tiers where monthly_spent_eur is not maintained consistently, could see changed figures.

proposal.target: quote_fx (FX tool, free-allowance handling for tier2)
proposal.change: Apply the remaining 200 EUR free allowance so the spread is charged only on the portion of the amount exceeding it, instead of on the full 3000 EUR.

--- a/fx/quote.py
+++ b/fx/quote.py
@@ quote_fx()
- taxable = amount
+ remaining_allowance = max(0.0, allowance_total_eur - allowance_used_before_eur)
